svg.title: single turn metrics: English labels
svg.desc: English text overlays. Embedded source image SHA-256: 6060ce134f9fcc864c3ae54377f29d41bf6b6ce25f4cab33ada211a280bba75a. Numeric plot content is retained.

text.tspan: json_validity: checks whether the response contains parseable JSON
tool_args_values: direct comparison of argument values (case-insensitive)
levenshtein_similarity: edit similarity between response texts
p_bert: BERTScore precision; a semantic comparison measure
bleu: BLEU score for output text quality
rouge: ROUGE-L, the longest common subsequence with the reference
meteor: METEOR, using synonyms and word stems
gpt_judge: mean of all GPT Judge rubric scores
required_fields: checks the presence of required response fields
jaccard_similarity: Jaccard similarity over shared tokens
gpt_context_relevance: GPT Judge assessment of contextual relevance
gpt_question_naturalness: GPT Judge assessment of question naturalness
gpt_reasoning_logic: GPT Judge assessment of written reasoning logic
gpt_tool_call_correctness: GPT Judge assessment of tool-call correctness
